_source: overhead 2/Engine.vb initHero and Heroes.vb loadHero, RECONSTRUCTION 4.1. All three heroes use the Chrono art set. Animation rates are seconds; speeds are world units per frame.

sprites._note: Textures.loadTextures: the Chrono set every hero draws with (64 x 64, magenta keyed). stand is face_* (one frame); walk and run are walk_*1..6 and run_*1..6, in frame order; draw and battle (combat\draw\draw_* and combat\battle_*, 1..6) were loaded for left and right only, left and down showing the left set, right and up the right one. Paths are under the original's folder, exactly as on disk.

locomotion._note: Heroes.aiWalking / aiRunning and Input.actionMove, RECONSTRUCTION 4.4 and 5.4. Per-frame figures are per 60 Hz tick (BIBLE). Held arrows move the velocity toward +/-walkSpeed or runSpeed by 'acceleration' each tick. The right button aims from the hero's point (heroSize x the fractions) to the cursor plus cursorOffset, each axis clamped to maxReach; at or beyond runReach on either axis (or with the run key) the hero runs while it has stamina, else walks with each axis clamped to runReach; velocity is the reach x followSpeed, x nearBoost within nearRange of the cursor on both axes, and the hero stops within arriveRange.

fall._note: Heroes.checkFall and recallHero, RECONSTRUCTION 3.7 and 4.5. A hero below z 0 rises by 'rise' each tick showing the halt_left picture, and is set to z 0 once it reaches it. A recalled hero is placed within +/- recallSpread / 2 of its leader on each axis (leader - spread/2 + spread x random) at z recallZ, so it falls into place.

follow._note: Heroes.checkfollow, RECONSTRUCTION 4.5: every hero no player leads, not in battle, while the team is on (bTeam, True at the start). Ranges are per axis (A_near_B, inclusive). Beyond recallRange on either axis the follower is recalled beside the leader (the 'fall' recall); within it on both it runs at velocity (leader - follower) x runSpeed, within walkRange walks at x walkSpeed, within standRange stands. Facing from dy's sign, unless |dx| is larger. Team off (the ' key or the team button): every follower kneels.

flocking._note: Heroes.checkFlocking, RECONSTRUCTION 4.5: two followers, both moving and alive, within range on both axes are each nudged apart in x by |dY| / divisor and in y by |dX| / divisor (a sideways slide), once a frame before the heroes update.

selection._note: Cursor.checkCursorOverHero, RECONSTRUCTION 4.7: the cursor is over the first hero whose point (position + heroSize x heroPoint + heroOffset) is within range on both axes of the cursor's position + cursorOffset. A left click there makes it the leader.

vitals._note: Heroes.checkStatus and checkRegen, Gui/StatusIcon.vb, RECONSTRUCTION 7. Every frame, a hero not Poisoned is Fine, Exhausted with stamina below exhaustedBelow x maxStamina, Angry (over Exhausted) with health below angryBelow x maxHealth; Poisoned stays until cured. In adventure mode, every regenRate seconds (common, 2): not poisoned, a kneeling hero not picking up gains kneelingStamina and a standing one standingStamina (capped at the maximum); poisoned, it loses poisonHealth health instead (floor 0); running, it loses runningStamina stamina (floor 0) either way. The icon is an iconSize square at the hero's position + iconOffset (left edge, vertical centre), each animation's frames advancing every iconRate seconds. The original's Poisoned folder is empty and it showed the Angry frames; the rebuild tints them poisonedTint (BIBLE).

rest._note: Input.actionRest, Heroes.aiKneeling, Sun.checkSleep, RECONSTRUCTION 6.4. The rest key kneels a standing hero, lays a kneeling one down and lifts a laid one back to kneeling. While laid, a held left or down arrow takes an hour off the sleep and right or up adds one, between minHours and maxHours, once more than chooserRate seconds have passed since the last check. Confirming while laid sleeps: every ambient channel falls fadeStep a tick to black; then every hero gains maximum x hours x restorePerHour health and mana (and stamina unless Poisoned), rounded as VB assigned a Double to an Integer and capped at the maximum, the clock moves on the hours, the hours return to minHours and the sleeper stands; then the ambient rises fadeStep a tick back to white.

battle._note: Heroes.checkRegen in battle mode and Input.actionBattleToggle, RECONSTRUCTION 7 and 12.1: once more than refillInterval seconds (refillInterval, 0.18) have passed since its last check, a hero Recharging gains refillStamina stamina and kneels; already full, it is Ready, gets up, its move distance is recomputed (agility x moveDistancePerAgility x stamina / maximum) and, unless it already holds its battle stance, draws its weapon (the draw cycle from its first frame at drawRate, then the battle cycle at battleRate from a random frame).
